translations.translation: Mouse capture OFF — profile mouse mode restored.

translations.translation: Mouse capture released. Click the screen to start capture; press the middle mouse button to release it.

translations.source: Bind app-specific mouse integration to the latest DOS Load/Exec (INT 21H AH=4BH). Under DOS extenders (RUN386), bind the .EXP payload when shown.

translations.source:
Open Memory scan to find guest RAM cursor coordinates.
Settings closes while the scan window is open.
translations.translation:
Open Memory scan to find guest RAM cursor coordinates.
Settings closes while the scan window is open.

translations.source:
Load a mouse-integration preset for this CD fingerprint.
Enabled when mouse_XXXXXXXX.ini is found. Apply or OK saves it to the disc profile.
translations.translation:
Load a mouse-integration preset for this CD fingerprint.
Enabled when mouse_XXXXXXXX.ini is found. Apply or OK saves it to the disc profile.

translations.source:
Write the current app-specific mouse settings to
~/.config/townsqt/mouse_presets/mouse_XXXXXXXX.ini.
Enabled when app-specific Phys is set.
translations.translation:
Write the current app-specific mouse settings to
~/.config/townsqt/mouse_presets/mouse_XXXXXXXX.ini.
Enabled when app-specific Phys is set.

translations.source: Optional second X/Y phys (below). Direct-write uses each row’s Scale on the mapped value.
translations.translation: Optional second X/Y phys (below). Direct-write uses each row’s Scale on the mapped value.

translations.source: Multiplies the mapped write value for this Phys pair (0 = no multiply).
translations.translation: Multiplies the mapped write value for this Phys pair (0 = no multiply).

translations.source:
On: poke Game Phys in guest RAM (range clamp).
Off: feed host−guest deltas through the gameport.
translations.translation:
On: poke Game Phys in guest RAM (range clamp).
Off: feed host−guest deltas through the gameport.

translations.source: Wait for gameport input to apply
translations.translation: Wait for gameport input to apply

translations.source: When on, hold the next gameport packet until Phys updates or the port is idle. Turn off for continuous refill (may oscillate on delayed guest feedback). Only used for gameport mode (memory write off).
translations.translation: When on, hold the next gameport packet until Phys updates or the port is idle. Turn off for continuous refill (may oscillate on delayed guest feedback). Only used for gameport mode (memory write off).

translations.source: Stop writing to Mouse BIOS soft-cursor phys
translations.translation: Stop writing to Mouse BIOS soft-cursor phys

translations.source: When on, do not write Mouse BIOS soft coordinates while MOS is alive. Game Phys / gameport still follow app-specific settings.
translations.translation: When on, do not write Mouse BIOS soft coordinates while MOS is alive. Game Phys / gameport still follow app-specific settings.

translations.source: Default: automatically switches between mouse integration (Mouse BIOS) and mouse capture to match Mouse BIOS. Titles without Mouse BIOS cannot use mouse integration.
translations.translation: Default: automatically switches between mouse integration (Mouse BIOS) and mouse capture to match Mouse BIOS. Titles without Mouse BIOS cannot use mouse integration.

translations.source: Mouse capture: always uses mouse capture. Mouse integration is not performed.
translations.translation: Mouse capture: always uses mouse capture. Mouse integration is not performed.

translations.source: Mouse integration (Mouse BIOS): forces mouse integration via Mouse BIOS. Titles without Mouse BIOS cannot use mouse integration.
translations.translation: Mouse integration (Mouse BIOS): forces mouse integration via Mouse BIOS. Titles without Mouse BIOS cannot use mouse integration.

translations.source: Mouse integration (Mouse BIOS): unavailable while the Mouse BIOS soft cursor cannot be resolved.
translations.translation: Mouse integration (Mouse BIOS): unavailable while the Mouse BIOS soft cursor cannot be resolved.

translations.source: Mouse integration (app-specific settings): follows Default until a bound EXP starts, then applies per-app Phys settings. Use Phys search to identify and set phys addresses for reading and writing the in-game cursor. “Memory write” pokes guest RAM; when off, host−guest deltas go through the gameport.
translations.translation: Mouse integration (app-specific settings): follows Default until a bound EXP starts, then applies per-app Phys settings. Use Phys search to identify and set phys addresses for reading and writing the in-game cursor. “Memory write” pokes guest RAM; when off, host−guest deltas go through the gameport.

translations.source:
Scan RAM for new coordinate candidates (also turns Mouse capture ON).
Move the mouse in the emu view.  ESC stops Scan and capture.
translations.translation:
Scan RAM for new coordinate candidates (also turns Mouse capture ON).
Move the mouse in the emu view.  ESC stops Scan and capture.

translations.source:
Alone: refresh list values and drop unrelated candidates (no new Scan picks).
Forced while Scan is on.  Press again or ESC restores the profile mouse mode.
translations.translation:
Alone: refresh list values and drop unrelated candidates (no new Scan picks).
Forced while Scan is on.  Press again or ESC restores the profile mouse mode.

translations.source:
Reset observed min..max on all candidates.
Starts again from the next sampled value.
translations.translation:
Reset observed min..max on all candidates.
Starts again from the next sampled value.

translations.source: Delete rows with none of Watch / Chase / X / Y / X2 / Y2 checked.
translations.translation: Delete rows with none of Watch / Chase / X / Y / X2 / Y2 checked.

translations.source:
Copy the checked X/Y pair (and min..max) into Mouse integration.
If X2/Y2 are also checked, fill Phys 2 as well.
Closes Memory scan and reopens Settings. Does not save — use Apply or OK there.
translations.translation:
Copy the checked X/Y pair (and min..max) into Mouse integration.
If X2/Y2 are also checked, fill Phys 2 as well.
Closes Memory scan and reopens Settings. Does not save — use Apply or OK there.

translations.source: Close Memory scan and return to Settings → Mouse integration.
translations.translation: Close Memory scan and return to Settings → Mouse integration.

translations.source:
Scan = add candidates (turns Mouse capture ON).
Mouse capture ON alone = refresh values / prune noise (no new picks).
Watch = keep in list after Scan stops.
Chase = follow guest-writer SOURCE; moves to the new SOURCE when found.
Also adds nearby phys (±32 bytes) whose value Δ matches host/IO mouse Δ.
X/Y = primary Game Phys pair.  X2/Y2 = optional Phys 2 pair.
Green phys = MOS soft-cursor words (writable if set as Phys).
Blue phys = disc-profile pair.  span = max−min; oversized rows are pruned.
ESC ends capture (+ Scan).
translations.translation:
Scan = add candidates (turns Mouse capture ON).
Mouse capture ON alone = refresh values / prune noise (no new picks).
Watch = keep in list after Scan stops.
Chase = follow guest-writer SOURCE; moves to the new SOURCE when found.
Also adds nearby phys (±32 bytes) whose value Δ matches host/IO mouse Δ.
X/Y = primary Game Phys pair.  X2/Y2 = optional Phys 2 pair.
Green phys = MOS soft-cursor words (writable if set as Phys).
Blue phys = disc-profile pair.  span = max−min; oversized rows are pruned.
ESC ends capture (+ Scan).

translations.source:
Delete the disc profile "%1"?
Per-disc machine and mouse settings will be removed.
This cannot be undone.

translations.source:
Editing Basics defaults (townsqt.conf). Apply or OK saves here.
Memory and CPU fidelity changes restart the emulator; game-port changes apply immediately.
Create a disc profile when a CD is mounted to save per-disc settings.
translations.translation:
Editing Basics defaults (townsqt.conf). Apply or OK saves here.
Memory and CPU fidelity changes restart the emulator; game-port changes apply immediately.

translations.source: Use sinc interpolation for PCM resampling
Without sinc interpolation, linear interpolation is used.
translations.translation: sinc 보간을 쓰지 않으면 선형 보간을 사용합니다.

translations.source: Changes take effect immediately when you press Apply or OK.
translations.translation: 적용 또는 확인 시 바로 반영됩니다.

translations.source:
Save settings per mounted CD as a disc profile under profiles/.
When enabled, a matching profile automatically overrides Basics defaults
at startup or when the CD is mounted. Floppy (FD0/FD1) mount state is
also stored and restored when the profile is applied.
translations.translation:
Save settings per mounted CD as a disc profile under profiles/.
When enabled, a matching profile automatically overrides Basics defaults
at startup or when the CD is mounted. Floppy (FD0/FD1) mount state is
also stored and restored when the profile is applied.

translations.source: Prevents automatic screen blanking/dimming on Wayland sessions.
translations.translation: Wayland 세션에서 화면 자동 꺼짐/어두워짐을 막습니다.

translations.source: Mouse BIOS integration that writes guest memory to reduce latency.
translations.translation: Mouse BIOS integration that writes guest memory to reduce latency.

translations.source:
Bulk-prefetch the CDDA audio track and keep playing through data reads
without interrupting playback. The value is how many seconds until
playback is considered finished.
translations.translation:
Bulk-prefetch the CDDA audio track and keep playing through data reads
without interrupting playback. The value is how many seconds until
playback is considered finished.

translations.source:
Even while Mouse BIOS is running, if it is unused, end mouse integration
and switch to mouse capture.
translations.translation:
Even while Mouse BIOS is running, if it is unused, end mouse integration
and switch to mouse capture.

translations.source: Available only on sessions that support Wayland idle-inhibit.
translations.translation: Wayland idle-inhibit를 지원하는 세션에서만 사용할 수 있습니다.

translations.source:
Editing the disc profile (fp_XXXXXXXX.ini, amber block).
Apply or OK saves clock, memory, ports, and options to the profile.
CPU and model stay global in townsqt.conf and are not stored in the profile.
Memory and CPU fidelity changes restart the emulator.
translations.translation:
Editing the disc profile (fp_XXXXXXXX.ini, amber block).
Apply or OK saves clock, memory, ports, and options to the profile.
CPU and model stay global in townsqt.conf and are not stored in the profile.

translations.source:
No disc profile for this CD yet. Use Create profile to save per-disc settings.
Until then, Apply or OK saves Basics defaults to townsqt.conf.
Memory and CPU fidelity changes restart the emulator; game-port changes apply immediately.
